title: Stormshield
caption:
This company steers hurricanes.

StormShield's coastal towers push storms back out to sea. It earns from yearly city protection fees, deals with insurers, and emergency call-outs when a storm forms.

narration: This company steers hurricanes. Meet StormShield, a weather engineering company on Meme Street's fictional market. Its coastal towers push storms back out to sea, before they reach land. It earns from yearly protection fees paid by coastal cities, deals with insurers who share the savings, and emergency call-outs when a storm forms. That means less damage, lower insurance bills, and safer coastlines. Its edge is a network of towers along the coast, which takes years to build. The risks? One storm it can't steer, rival CloudSeed, and neighbours who don't want storms pushed their way. On Meme Street, stories like these hit the news wire, and the price reacts. Find StormShield, at memestreet.net.
